Message.MsgText: An Exception occurred when using the Naming and Reconciliation Service API.

Explanation.p: The Component was not able to use the IT registry Naming and Reconciliation Service. Check the provided Exception for details.

OperatorResponse.p: For more information please refer to the logs of the Naming and Reconciliation Service API.

Message.MsgText: An Exception occurred during a database operation when using Naming and Reconciliation Service API.

Explanation.p: The Component was not able to use the IT registry database. Check the provided Exception for details.

OperatorResponse.p: For more information please refer to the logs of Naming and Reconciliation Service API.

Message.MsgText: The parameter param name was initialized with the value: 'value'.
Init IT registry Function Component will work with book: 'book name'.
Init IT registry Function Component will work with Refresh set to: 'value'.
The Common Data Model version of the registered MSS will be 'cdm version'.

Explanation.p: The specified parameter is needed by the Init IT registry Function Component and must be provided.

OperatorResponse.p: Provide a value for this parameter.

Message.MsgText: Use an IT registry system for the needed meta-data: 'use it registry'.
Init IT registry Function Component accepts only a SyncWeave Entry as input.

Explanation.p: At the beginning of the Function Component's execution cycle the input data passed was not a SyncWeave Entry.

OperatorResponse.p: Init IT registry Function Component expects only a SyncWeave Entry as input. Check the AL logic and try again.

Message.MsgText: The Common Data Model version specified 'param name' is not a valid Common Data Model version.

Explanation.p: The Common Data Model version should be in a format of three dot-separated numbers.

OperatorResponse.p: Please specify value of Common Data Model version in a format of three dot-separated numbers.

Message.MsgText: The MSS's param name has value: 'value'.
Either MSS Name or Manufacturer Name, Hostname and Product Name are not set in output map of FC.

Explanation.p: Either MSS Name or Manufacturer Name, Hostname and Product Name are mandatory for an MSS registration.

OperatorResponse.p: Please provide the listed information in the FC's Output Map.

Message.MsgText: The Common Data Model version is not set in configuration panel of FC.

Explanation.p: Common Data Model version is mandatory for an MSS registration.

OperatorResponse.p: Please provide a valid Common Data Model version in the FC's Configuration panel.

Message.MsgText: The name of the currently used book 'book name' has been overridden to 'new name'.
JDBC parameter 'param name' is not set in Configuration panel of FC and can not be read from the IT registry's properties file.

Explanation.p: This JDBC parameter is mandatory for an MSS registration.

OperatorResponse.p: Please provide this parameter either in Configuration panel or in IT registry's properties file.

Message.MsgText: Init IT registry Function Component has already opened book 'book name'.
The book 'book name' is opened and currently used.

Explanation.p: The book with the provided book name is currently in use by another Init IT registry Function Component. It will have to release it before this Component can use it.

OperatorResponse.p: Check if there is another running AssemblyLine with IT registry Components. If the problem persists either provide another book name for your IT registry Components or restart the SDI server.
